notes: The recorded contact source (http://www.wildersuntanzania.com/contact-us) is readable but names him only as '(Ervin)' beside a telephone number, with no surname or role; that number was not recorded. The role was confirmed on the About page, where the excerpt sits in the paragraph under the heading 'Ervin Nunes'. The profile's education and career details were not recorded. The same page says 'Lillian has been the company's General Manager since 2009', a possible senior route. The site text looks dated: it says 'over 35 years' for a company registered in 1980. The staff figure (35 employees) may therefore be old, so the hook uses the education fact instead.

notes: The contact source https://zaratanzaniaadventures.com/ceo-story/ now redirects to /meet-the-ceo/. This site returns gzip-compressed pages that read_page.py does not decode, so the cached copies were decompressed locally; nothing else was worked around. The CEO page reads like an article from the COVID-19 period ('amidst the COVID-19 pandemic'), so the 1,410 employee figure may be dated; the hook uses the charity fact. The company is based in Moshi (head office on Tembo Road, Pasua Area); no Arusha office was found, so check the fit with the nearest campus. The CEO page lists the founder's personal awards; for the contact only her name and role were recorded. The page's phrase 'sustaining thousands of families' was not used.
